artifacts.prompt:
Create one lettermark logo for NORTHLINE. Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): 'NL'. Exact slogan: ''.
Render only the supplied exact text and nonempty slogan; the brand context is not additional lettering. Empty strings request no corresponding text.
Industry: a boutique guesthouse and independent travel journal. Audience: everyday consumer audiences; independent lifestyle businesses.
Styles: soft editorial serif initials. Original brief palette context: muted aubergine, uniform white background.
Avoid: industrial or manufacturing aesthetic, mechanical brackets, cut-metal blocks and engineering crests, extra lettering, slogans or watermarks, mockup scenes, collage or presentation board, colored canvas or transparent background. Use cases: brand identity at 240px width and README.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: Exactly NL as two separate readable uppercase initials for a warm boutique guesthouse. Draw broad elegant N and L in a soft editorial serif with curved bracketed serifs and medium stroke contrast. N has softly flaring stems and a rounded meeting at its diagonal; L has a gently cupped foot that sweeps slightly upward at the end, echoing a quiet upholstered seat. Letters sit next to each other on the same baseline, do not overlap or share strokes. A carefully balanced open interval separates the N diagonal from the L stem. Rich muted aubergine flat ink. Centered compact two-letter signature, 58% canvas width. No squared monoliths, stencil cuts, mountains, compass, arrow, shield or hotel crest.. Assumptions: Fictional demonstration brand. Design decisions are assistant proposals; user preference is pending., Preserve the existing exact string and white-background collection intent., One independent original, square canvas. Color descriptions are intent, not certified pixel values..
Logo construction: Make a lettering-only lettermark from the supplied exact text: keep the characters distinct readable letters, not an interwoven monogram. Do not derive new initials from the brand name or expand them into a wordmark. Use a shared geometric module, stroke weight and corner family; balance counters and optical gaps. Stack letters only when requested by the concept, retaining their order and script structure; stacking letters does not add a symbol or create a symbol-plus-text lockup. Do not add an unsolicited pictogram. Use style references for broad construction traits, not their brand words or traced signature shapes. The identity should remain recognizable in a one-color silhouette at the intended use size. This construction check does not replace the requested palette or request an extra monochrome image.
Lettering fidelity: preserve every Unicode character, capitalization, punctuation, space and reading order in the applicable text. Keep Hangul syllable blocks intact; do not translate, romanize, abbreviate or substitute lookalike glyphs. Shape changes must keep required text readable, including counters and joins at the intended size.
Output one square PNG containing only this single identity on a uniform white background. Clean, crisp raster edges; do not add paper grain or texture to flat ink.
